PRIORITY_CRITERION: P0/P1 only when absence could make the first integrated workflow misleading, professionally implausible, or unable to expose a necessary owner decision.

FIRST_RUNTIME_GAP.EVIDENCE: No RC01 source or REFERENCE-CORPUS-01 identifier is imported or registered under src; the current registry contains assertion-layer, knowledge-graph, P4/P4R, P5 and RB-003/004/005 only.
FIRST_RUNTIME_GAP.CONSEQUENCE: Knowledge cannot select any RC01 source, before document ingestion, indexing, anchor mapping, applicability filtering or owner delivery can occur.

GAPS.TITLE: Reference Corpus 01 registry is not visible to Knowledge
GAPS.JUSTIFICATION: The corpus can support audit only; no RC01 source can be selected, traced or returned by the sole external-evidence gateway.
GAPS.SAFE_DEGRADATION: Keep all RC01 support unavailable at runtime and expose explicit coverage gaps; no direct owner PDF access.

GAPS.TITLE: External documents are not ingested as versioned Knowledge document snapshots
GAPS.JUSTIFICATION: Metadata visibility alone cannot support a methodological statement; Knowledge needs actual admissible content and an immutable representation digest.
GAPS.SAFE_DEGRADATION: Remote-only sources remain MISSING_SOURCE_ACCESS; the five local FDA PDFs remain audit inputs only.

GAPS.TITLE: No RC01 retrieval index or deterministic source-anchor mapping
GAPS.JUSTIFICATION: Without owner-need/query mapping and exact anchors, a returned title would not be verifiable evidence and could not satisfy KE-001.
GAPS.SAFE_DEGRADATION: Return metadata/gap only; never infer a claim from title or full-document proximity.

GAPS.TITLE: Knowledge query/result handoff is absent for several current owners
GAPS.JUSTIFICATION: Scientific Thinking and Imaging consume KnowledgeResult, but current Study Design, OBS, Biostatistics, CDM and DM native inputs do not; KnowledgeRequest consumer values also do not cover them. A registry adapter alone would not deliver evidence to these owners.
GAPS.SAFE_DEGRADATION: Owners keep proposals bounded and explicitly unsupported; no hidden source access or automatic adoption.

GAPS.TITLE: OBS runtime omits structured validity, performance, error, confounder, quality and harmonization reasoning
GAPS.JUSTIFICATION: The normative owner knows these dimensions, but the current result contract validates only supplied properties, measurements and roles. A human test could otherwise mistake structurally valid declarations for qualified measurement options.
GAPS.SAFE_DEGRADATION: Return INFORMATION_REQUIRED or proposal-only output; do not claim validity/performance.

GAPS.TITLE: Biostatistics runtime is narrower than its normative decision classes
GAPS.JUSTIFICATION: The current runtime exposes four method families, model=null and one bounded two-group continuous calculation; diagnostics, non-inferiority/equivalence and several dimensioning targets remain unrepresented.
GAPS.SAFE_DEGRADATION: Keep affected analyses/dimensioning as explicit information needs and do not calculate or recommend.

GAPS.TITLE: External data-standard mapping is not executable or conformance-qualified
GAPS.JUSTIFICATION: CDM preserves canonical identity, but current runtime does not map/validate CDASH, SDTM, ADaM, ODM or terminology packages.
GAPS.SAFE_DEGRADATION: Preserve NOXIA identity and mark mappings unsupported.

GAPS.TITLE: General mechanistic and alternative-model evidence is domain-limited
GAPS.JUSTIFICATION: Current P4R/P5 and Reasoning Books cover selected imaging domains, not general scientific mechanisms.
GAPS.SAFE_DEGRADATION: Expose NO_ASSERTION_MATCH/NO_REGISTERED_PROVIDER and request bounded external research.

GAPS.TITLE: Study-design coverage is weak for observational, diagnostic-accuracy and device/IVD families
GAPS.JUSTIFICATION: The current seed is strong for general and regulated interventional trial design but can under-support common imaging/observational projects in Protocol Designer.
GAPS.SAFE_DEGRADATION: Keep family options non-adopted and label design-specific evidence unavailable.

GAPS.TITLE: Generic cross-domain measurement validity and performance corpus is absent
GAPS.JUSTIFICATION: QIBA/FDA sources are valuable for imaging, but laboratory, clinical-assessment and device/wearable measurement contexts remain unsupported.
GAPS.SAFE_DEGRADATION: Route to the domain specialist and keep validity/performance UNKNOWN.

GAPS.TITLE: Imaging charter, Core Lab, transfer, scanner qualification and reader manuals are missing
GAPS.JUSTIFICATION: FDA/QIBA support principles and profiles, but not the recurring operational dependencies needed to present a professionally credible imaging workflow.
GAPS.SAFE_DEGRADATION: Keep Level-3/executable imaging protocol blocked and surface explicit Core Lab/charter/transfer gaps.

GAPS.TITLE: Precision, observational, cluster and diagnostic-study dimensioning references are insufficient
GAPS.JUSTIFICATION: For the likely observational/imaging first tests, forcing an effect-based two-group calculation would be misleading; sources must support distinct sizing objectives.
GAPS.SAFE_DEGRADATION: Return DIMENSIONING_INFORMATION_REQUIRED and no effect-size/sample-size recommendation.

GAPS.TITLE: No linked Protocol to CRF to Data Dictionary to DMP to SAP set
GAPS.JUSTIFICATION: Standards describe structures, but linked real artifacts are needed to study identity/version propagation and workflow dependencies without inventing them.
GAPS.SAFE_DEGRADATION: Use standards as reference only and do not claim real-workflow propagation coverage.

GAPS.TITLE: No lab manual or biospecimen chain artifact set
GAPS.JUSTIFICATION: Current corpus provides only generic DMP/CRF practice pointers for material collection.
GAPS.SAFE_DEGRADATION: Preserve biospecimen objects and request project-specific handling information.

GAPS.TITLE: Real DMP, query/reconciliation, lock/release and French DM manuals are missing
GAPS.JUSTIFICATION: Current standards/best-practice sources show principles but not a linked operational lifecycle with versions and dispositions.
GAPS.SAFE_DEGRADATION: Keep lifecycle structures generic, require project roles/decisions and make no database-readiness claim.

GAPS.TITLE: Current ANSM and document-level CTIS/EMA process corpus is absent
GAPS.JUSTIFICATION: EU regulations and living hubs do not by themselves resolve current French operational requirements or substantial-modification workflows.
GAPS.SAFE_DEGRADATION: Return UNKNOWN_REQUIRES_QUALIFICATION and require REG/human review; never infer French rules from FDA.

GAPS.TITLE: Safety and device/IVD/software/AI regulatory coverage is insufficient
GAPS.JUSTIFICATION: The seed has ICH E2A and EU CTR but lacks a bounded current EU/French operational safety set and product-specific pathways.
GAPS.SAFE_DEGRADATION: Keep applicability unknown and route to human/external regulatory qualification.

GAPS.TITLE: French sponsor operational manuals are sparse
GAPS.JUSTIFICATION: The corpus is strong internationally and for French privacy/funding, but weak for French sponsor QA, data-management, monitoring and feasibility practice.
GAPS.SAFE_DEGRADATION: Label practices international/contextual and require local sponsor information.

GAPS.TITLE: Current linked sets do not demonstrate full document propagation
GAPS.JUSTIFICATION: Five sets link protocol/SAP/ICF only; none contains CRF, dictionary, DMP, imaging charter, Core Lab manual, data release, code or publication.
GAPS.SAFE_DEGRADATION: Use only same-study identity and partial protocol/SAP lineage as practice-pattern candidates.

GAPS.TITLE: Current program financial annexes and eligible-cost matrices are missing
GAPS.JUSTIFICATION: Funding coverage establishes current/historical program discovery but not a current executable budget rule set.
GAPS.SAFE_DEGRADATION: Keep FUTURE_BUDGET_FEASIBILITY inactive and separate generic costs from program rules.

GAPS.TITLE: Scientific context may be insufficient for evidence applicability or information value
GAPS.JUSTIFICATION: Population, phenomenon, timing and intended use are Project facts, not corpus content.
GAPS.SAFE_DEGRADATION: QRY requests only material missing information; Knowledge returns MISSING_CRITICAL_CONTEXT.

GAPS.TITLE: Operational measurement/data context may be missing
GAPS.JUSTIFICATION: Sites, equipment, sources, occurrences and actual missingness must come from the current Project/runtime facts.
GAPS.SAFE_DEGRADATION: Preserve UNKNOWN/WITHHELD and block executable conclusions.

GAPS.TITLE: Regulatory/privacy classification facts may be missing
GAPS.JUSTIFICATION: Jurisdiction, product/study classification, roles, transfers and legal basis cannot be supplied by a general corpus.
GAPS.SAFE_DEGRADATION: Return UNKNOWN_MISSING_INFORMATION or UNKNOWN_REQUIRES_QUALIFICATION and request a mandated human decision.

HUMAN_ONLY_AREAS: Adoption or rejection of any scientific question, hypothesis, design, measurement, acquisition, analysis or Project contribution.
Residual uncertainty, bias, validity, performance and risk acceptance.
Regulatory/legal qualification, mandate, safety classification and concrete submission action.
Freeze, lock, unlock, release, database readiness and document approval.
Scientific/clinical interpretation and any association-to-causality promotion.
Funding-program selection, eligibility and budget commitment.
